note: Primary fixture alias for #92548. Remote daemon never releases chat processes and outlives its clients. Faceplate: accruing.
title: Remote daemons never release chat processes and outlive their clients (self-hosted, ~300MB/chat, two hard outages)
expected: A chat process is released when the chat is closed or after idle; reopen reuses the same --resume berth; a daemon exits after last client or hands sessions to the successor; session lifecycle is visible and controllable from the apps.
actual: ccd-cli ~300MB per chat never freed. Reopen under the same daemon duplicates the --resume UUID. Client updates start a new socket while the old daemon keeps every chat. Prune deletes binaries but leaves hulks running. No idle timeout, session cap, or eviction. Two hard host outages.
repro: Open a chat, close it, reopen it, inspect ccd-cli. Two processes for one conversation, neither released. Desktop and mobile over Tailscale SSH on Unraid; no terminal required for the leak.
